meals.note: Eat first, then recruit Ultand and Ninae once this meal tips them to Support 3. Diego starts toward Support 2.
Simon sits every Sunday until Support 3: he joins 7/1. Diego toward Support 2; Seteth (filler) supports Loretta.

gifts.note: Nothing they like is buyable yet: meals carry them

weekly.text: Tobias, the sitting wall and the bench run dungeon parties every week: their only EXP

missables.text: Pick one Sealed Letter quest: a route allows only one of the two
missables.lose: the other quest and its follow-ups

options.gives: A longer chain ending in the Haze Badge

note.text: Side trips fill the wait for Renown 8 and Lv 35: switch each unit once its Specialty mastery shows
detail: Tobias Brigand (on the bench), Lilian Rogue, Lysander Archer. Advanced exams start in Ch 10.
Alexandra, Ultand and Ninae join about Lv 15: exams at Lv 20 (Ch 9).

override.text: Only if Bow C is in and Flying C, Axe B, Spear B are on track; else stay Armored Ornius Rider

assign.why: Hit +20 on arts; his Archer's Ring goes to Nydine (Ch 9)
Legacy of a Legendary Sculptor copy: Flying D for Ch 9
Rare Stone Hunting reward: his Archer side trip bow
Dione Fort chest copy: Res +5 on the wall

buy.text: Dagsion: [[item:Da Mina Axe]] and [[item:Da Mina Sword]] for Tobias (Brigand from Ch 8)
detail: Alexandra trains Sword and Spear C on an [[item:Iron Sword]] and [[item:Iron Spear]]: Da Mina at Ch 9.
Ultand's and Ninae's spears: their build pages.

note.text: Blacksmith: repairs only until Renown 7 (late Ch 8). Bank Smithing Stones and rare ores
detail: Ch 9 is the +1 week, Ch 12 the +2 week: the Ledger's refine plan.

recruits.action: Recruit her: she takes Zarcone's seat
detail: Renown 6 (lands in Ch 7). She arrives about Lv 15: feed her kills to Lv 20 for Ch 9.
Zarcone goes to storage; the Hammer waits for Tobias in Ch 10.

recruits.action: Finish her short quest at Support 3 and Renown 6: the Fortress second wall
detail: About Lv 15: Priest at Lv 20 (Ch 9), Guardian at Lv 35. Holds slot 9 from Ch 8.
Patch Up and Pray for Safety work only adjacent: end her turns next to Theodora.
Supports Tobias and Loretta; Cha 50 carries a battalion.

recruits.action: Bring 1 Paradise Fish at Support 3 and Renown 6: the wall on mage maps
detail: About Lv 15: Priest at Lv 20 (Ch 9), Physic at White Magic B, Guardian at Lv 35.
She shares slot 9 with Ultand: Spirits' Guidance (Hit/Avo +10 vs magic) on mage maps.
EXP on her off maps: dungeon parties. Supports Simon, Lysander and Sirocco.

recruits.action: Recruit her at Renown 3: Part II dodge bait, and she carries Ursa's Right Claw
detail: Store the Claw for Anatolia (Part III); it is cursed (Curse 1): hold it to the end of Part I.
Bench: dungeon parties and Arena seats (White D, Gauntlet B for War Monk).

callout.text: Player report: by Ch 8 she joins a Pugilist with the Claw. Check her class first ?

prep.text: Loretta or Nydine not in yet? Their recruit rows are in Ch 7: recruit them this week
Keep Simon at every Sunday meal: Support 3 and Renown 7 (late Ch 8) let him join on 7/1
Nuzzuo (this map's boss) shows in Dagsion about 7/1: buy 3 Iron Bows now for his Ch 9 recruit

route.note: Hand in both of this chapter's pair now if you can, even though they're due 10/24
Nobody takes Cataphract and no route follows: do the pair for gold and Renown

sub.note: Its White-Magic Manual goes to Theodora (White Magic B by Ch 10)
Take it the day the Theater opens (Renown 7, usually late Ch 8)

explore.text: Check north of Temple Row for Anna's Shop: her stock rotates
Assign squads to the joins: Hunter-Drifters to Loretta, then the walls and Noctula
detail: [[battalion:Hunter-Drifters]] (Zarcone's) to Loretta, [[battalion:Bronze-Shield Guard]] to Ultand.
[[battalion:Rookie Vanguard]] to Ninae; Noctula takes the spare [[battalion:Rookie Soldiers]].
Alexandra carries none once she flies (Ch 9). Renown 7 (late Ch 8): more deploy slots ?

explore.text: Run [[place:Dione Fort]] (Lv 18, Castalia) with the bench: [[item:Hexlock Shield]] for Ninae
detail: Also a Flying Manual (spare) and a Concoction.

explore.text: Run Enno Isle (Lv 24, Danann Sea) with Tobias as the carry and the Lv 15 joins
detail: Nydine, Noctula and whichever wall sits: feed them the kills; link attacks raise Support too.
Chests (Ch 7): Bullion, Healing Staff, Short Axe. Enemies return each chapter.

explore.text: Spend any Turns still left on Inn Auto-Activities

battle.title: vs. the Har Hali
battle.lose: 20 turns pass (he retreats) or Theodora falls

tips.text: Go east, then north: slower but safer, so watch the turn count
Nuzzuo retreats after 20 turns; he's recruitable in Dagsion from about 7/1 (Ch 9 week 1)
No Hammer here: Theodora's Halberd, both casters and Alexandra's Levin Sword (Sword C) break armor
